thread:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty SEV2 triggered for inference-prod - elevated 5xx rate and degraded p95 latency. Paging @oncall.
Sam R: I'm on it. seeing spike in model-inference 5xxs across us-east-1 nodes. quick confirm: is this single model or multi-model?
Priya N: looks multi-model from the first glance, but concentrated on endpoints behind the routing layer. dashboards show error-rate jump at 15:42 UTC.
Khalid: I just queried logs, but sampling was set to 10% for /inference the last 12h. grabbing what I can. we might be missing full traces. :grimacing:
Jordy S: tagging that as an observability gap—sampling changed in the deploy yesterday. @Maria P can you confirm who changed sampling?
Maria P: that was me, adjusted sampling to 10% to reduce logging cost for non-prod ingestion. I thought it was only non-prod but maybe rollout hit prod traffic route accidentally. Sorry.
Sam R: ok this matters. we need higher fidelity for next 30m. @Priya N can you flip sampling to 100% for the inference-prod route and keep it for 20m? also spin up a short retention export.
Priya N: on it. running command now: ```kubectl patch configmap observability -n infra --type merge -p '{"data":{"sampling.inference-prod":"100"}}'``` will confirm when propagation done.
pd-bot: PagerDuty: Acknowledged by Sam R. Handoff window: 2026-03-15 15:45 UTC -> 16:45 UTC.
Alex K: while sampling increases, we should capture a short packet-level capture for 5m on the most impacted nodes. I'll start tcpdump on node-gpu-12 and node-gpu-14. placing results in /tmp/incident-dumps/1798301234.pcap.gz
Khalid: thanks. also running ad-hoc query (splunk): ```index=infra logs "inference" | stats count by status, endpoint | where status>=500``` initial run shows endpoint /v1/generate and /v1/chat most affected, status 503 and 504.
Jordy S: hypothesis 1: upstream cache/kv eviction causing backend to miss warmed cache and overload model servers. hypothesis 2: routing change sent heavier batched requests to smaller instance types.
Sam R: add hypothesis 3: tokenization/transform library was patched yesterday (eng-runtime) — could be causing serialization errors under certain payload sizes. @Maria P did that change land yesterday?
Maria P: yes, runtime PR #4287 merged 03/14 22:10 UTC. rolled in canary but should not have reached production. checking rollout history.
Priya N: sampling is at 100% across prod routes now (15:51 UTC). exporting 10m of raw logs to s3: s3://redwood-incident-exports/1798301234/raw-15m.gz.
Khalid: uploaded partial logs: s3://redwood-incident-exports/1798301234/partial-logs.ndjson (contains 35k entries) — note: traces only present for ~30% due to trace-sampling config.
Sam R: good. can folks paste any error stack snippets here? need concrete failure modes.
Alex K: stack from node-gpu-12: ```2026-03-15T15:48:12Z ERROR: kv_cache_miss: model_id=redwood-13b shard=2 runtime_timeout after 120s
Trace: rpc timeout -> deserializing request -> abort
``` not many full traces tied to request ids though.
Jordy S: putting a running timeline in-thread: 15:42 UTC error spike starts; 15:45 on-call page; 15:48 first kv timeout logs; 15:51 sampling bumped to 100%; 15:54 pcap started; 15:58 partial retries observed from routing layer; 16:10 autoscaler triggered 2x but new instances returned 504s; 16:30 mitigation: roll back routing policy to old weights.
Priya N: rollback done at 16:30 UTC — early signs of recovery in p50 latency.
Sam R: current customer impact: some API calls returning 503/504 intermittently for ~48k requests over window. CS alerted. adding to incident timeline for RCA.
Maria P: note for RCA - we need to capture who changed sampling and why prod got the config. that's an ops->deploy process gap.
Khalid: observability gaps list: 1) sampling change applied to prod routes; 2) trace sampling still low; 3) dashboards rely on aggregated metrics so spikes obscured until we bring p95 time-series into view; 4) log retention/export needs to be easier (ad-hoc exports blocked by perms).
Sam R: immediate mitigation tasks: (A) keep sampling at 100% for 30m, (B) keep packet captures until 16:05 UTC, (C) request runtime rollback/patch audit with eng-runtime, (D) add emergency log export perms for oncall.
Jordy S: I'm going to collect PRs touching tokenizer/runtime around 03/14-03/15 and open a channel with eng-runtime. tagging @Priya N and @Alex K for artifacts.
Priya N: export complete and shared link to S3 above. increasing retention on that object to 30d.
IncidentBot: Incident updated: status=mitigating, impact=partial, owner=Sam R.
Sam R: good work team — we'll keep this thread as the RCA coordination space. after recovery, we'll need a separate writeup. for now, keep pasting logs, stack traces, and timeline updates here. :thumbsup:
